panels.description: Sum of Reps x Weight_kg across all sets in range (Weight_kg>0 only; excludes cardio warmups).

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT sum(vol) AS total_volume FROM f

panels.title: Total Volume

panels.description: Count of sets with Weight_kg > 0 in range. This excludes bodyweight/cardio-only entries (e.g. unweighted pull-ups, ROW/INDOOR_ROW warmups) that are logged inside strength activities but carry no load — so this number is lower than the raw row count for the same range. See 'Sets Needing Classification' below for data-quality flags.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT count(Reps) AS total_sets FROM f

panels.title: Weighted Sets

panels.description: Sum of reps across weighted sets in range.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT sum(Reps) AS total_reps FROM f

panels.title: Total Reps

panels.description: Distinct days with at least one weighted set (one row per training day).

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT count(DISTINCT activity_id) AS workouts FROM f

panels.title: Number of Workouts

panels.description: Mean per-workout training volume in range.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT avg(volume) AS avg_volume FROM (SELECT sum(vol) AS volume FROM f GROUP BY activity_id) q

panels.title: Avg Volume / Workout

panels.description: Best estimated 1-rep max per exercise per workout day, using the Epley formula Weight_kg * (1 + Reps/30). Filter by $ExerciseCategory / $ExerciseLabel above. This is the single most useful panel for tracking progressive overload.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND (time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '2 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' AND COALESCE(local_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT COALESCE(local_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, (date_trunc('day', time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})) AS time, max(epley) AS e1rm, ExerciseLabel AS metric FROM f WHERE true AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseCategory IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseLabel:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseLabel IN (${ExerciseLabel:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,3 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Estimated 1RM Progression (Epley) by Exercise

panels.description: Total volume (kg) per workout day (Reps x Weight_kg, summed across all weighted sets that day).

targets.rawSql: SELECT q."time" AS "Time", q."Volume" FROM (WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND (time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '2 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' AND COALESCE(local_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT COALESCE(local_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, (date_trunc('day', time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})) AS time, sum(vol) AS "Volume" FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) q ORDER BY "Time" ASC

panels.title: Training Volume per Workout

panels.description: Heaviest single set and best estimated 1RM (Epley) per exercise in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT ExerciseLabel AS "Exercise", max(Weight_kg) AS "Max Weight (kg)", max(epley) AS "Best Est. 1RM (kg)" FROM f WHERE true AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseCategory IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseLabel:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseLabel IN (${ExerciseLabel:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Personal Records (Top Set & Est. 1RM)

panels.description: Training volume (kg) split by exercise category — shows muscle-group balance.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT ExerciseCategory AS "ExerciseCategory", sum(vol) AS "Volume" FROM f WHERE true AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseCategory IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Volume by Category

panels.description: Number of weighted sets per exercise category — complements the volume pie (a category can have many sets but low volume, or vice versa).

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT ExerciseCategory AS "ExerciseCategory", count(Reps) AS "Sets" FROM f WHERE true AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseCategory IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Sets by Category

panels.description: Most recent individual sets: exercise, reps, weight, and volume.

targets.rawSql: SELECT q."time" AS "Time", q."Exercise", q."Reps", q."Weight (kg)", q."Volume (kg)", q."Set #" FROM (WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT time, ExerciseLabel AS "Exercise", Reps AS "Reps", Weight_kg AS "Weight (kg)", vol AS "Volume (kg)", SetOrder AS "Set #" FROM f WHERE true AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseCategory IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseLabel:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseLabel IN (${ExerciseLabel:sqlstring})) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100) q ORDER BY "Time" DESC

panels.title: Recent Sets (Workout Detail)

panels.description: One row per workout day: total sets, reps, volume, and cumulative active set duration. Not filtered by exercise picker (whole-session view).

targets.rawSql: SELECT q."time" AS "Time", q."Sets", q."Reps", q."Volume (kg)", q."Time Under Tension (s)" FROM (WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND (time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '2 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' AND COALESCE(local_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT COALESCE(local_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, (date_trunc('day', time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})) AS time, count(Reps) AS "Sets", sum(Reps) AS "Reps", sum(vol) AS "Volume (kg)", sum(Duration_s) AS "Time Under Tension (s)" FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) q ORDER BY "Time" ASC

panels.title: Workout Summary (per session)

panels.description: Time spent in each heart-rate zone during strength sessions, from StrengthHRZones. ZoneNumber/ZoneLowBoundary are per-activity fields (not tags), so each zone is queried as a separate target filtered by ZoneNumber.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(health_number(fields, 'SecsInZone')) AS "Zone 1" FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthHRZones' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND health_number(fields, 'ZoneNumber')=1

SELECT sum(health_number(fields, 'SecsInZone')) AS "Zone 2" FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthHRZones' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND health_number(fields, 'ZoneNumber')=2

SELECT sum(health_number(fields, 'SecsInZone')) AS "Zone 3" FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthHRZones' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND health_number(fields, 'ZoneNumber')=3

SELECT sum(health_number(fields, 'SecsInZone')) AS "Zone 4" FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthHRZones' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND health_number(fields, 'ZoneNumber')=4

SELECT sum(health_number(fields, 'SecsInZone')) AS "Zone 5" FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthHRZones' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time) AND health_number(fields, 'ZoneNumber')=5

panels.title: HR Zone Time Distribution (Strength Sessions)

panels.description: Total accumulated active-set duration (sum of Duration_s) per exercise in the selected range.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT ExerciseLabel AS "Exercise", sum(Duration_s) AS "Total Time Under Tension (s)" FROM f WHERE true AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseCategory IN (${ExerciseCategory:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${ExerciseLabel:sqlstring}) OR ExerciseLabel IN (${ExerciseLabel:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Time Under Tension by Exercise

panels.description: Count of training days bucketed into weekly bins. fill(0) is intentional here: a week with no workout genuinely has zero, not missing data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT q."time" AS "Time", q."Workouts" FROM (WITH aggregated AS (WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT (date_trunc('week', time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AS time, count(DISTINCT activity_id) AS "Workouts" FROM f GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1), buckets AS (SELECT d AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time FROM generate_series(date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}), date_trunc('week', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}), interval '1 week') d) SELECT b.time, COALESCE(a."Workouts",0) AS "Workouts" FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN aggregated a USING(time) ORDER BY b.time) q ORDER BY "Time" ASC

panels.title: Workouts per Week

panels.description: One cell per calendar day: green = at least one weighted set logged that day, gray = rest day.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND (time >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '2 days' AND time <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz + interval '2 days' AND COALESCE(local_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT days.time AS time, COALESCE(n,0) AS sets FROM (SELECT d AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring} AS time FROM generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}), date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}), interval '1 day') d) days LEFT JOIN (SELECT COALESCE(local_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}, (date_trunc('day', time AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring}) AT TIME ZONE ${TimeZone:sqlstring})) AS day, count(*) AS n FROM f GROUP BY 1) x ON x.day=days.time ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Workout Calendar

panels.description: Sets Garmin could not classify into an exercise (ExerciseCategory=UNKNOWN). Not dropped from other panels, but flagged here — fix labels in Garmin Connect to improve categorization.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT time, local_date, tags->>'ActivityID' AS activity_id, tags->>'ExerciseLabel' AS ExerciseLabel, tags->>'ExerciseCategory' AS ExerciseCategory, health_number(fields, 'Reps') AS Reps, health_number(fields, 'Weight_kg') AS Weight_kg, health_number(fields, 'Duration_s') AS Duration_s, health_number(fields, 'SetOrder') AS SetOrder FROM all_records WHERE dataset='StrengthExerciseSet' AND source_id IN (${Source:csv}) AND $__timeFilter(time)), f AS (SELECT *, Reps*Weight_kg AS vol, Weight_kg*(1+Reps/30.0) AS epley FROM s WHERE Weight_kg > 0 AND ExerciseLabel != 'ROW/INDOOR_ROW' AND ExerciseCategory != 'RUN') SELECT count(*) AS unknown_sets FROM s WHERE ExerciseCategory='UNKNOWN'
